name: chat-heldout-v1
about: Locked business questions over evals/fixture.mjs. A case is grounded when every expect group has a match in the final answer, no forbid pattern matches, and the status is the one listed. Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions; the answer is read with Thai digits as Arabic and without thousands separators.
